clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years) 1 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 1 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 3 Lakh (s) /Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: The OEM must have an average turnover of Rs 3 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s) MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: Three years of past experience is required, with complete relaxation for MSEs.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Bidders must submit experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorization and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: /EMD Detail N /Required No
clauses.summary: The bid details state that EMD is not required.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: A bidder that is itself an MSE OEM is relaxed from the OEM average turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is DPIIT Registered OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: A bidder that is a DPIIT-registered OEM is relaxed from the OEM average turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Turnover must be proven with audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the required number of financial years.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted for each financial year of experience.

clauses.heading: 7. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid document.

clauses.heading: 9. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 50% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 50% of the bid quantity to a government body in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 2 Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
clauses.quote: Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses EMD 4500 WILL HAVE TO BE PAID
clauses.summary: The buyer's additional terms require an EMD of Rs 4,500 to be paid.

clauses.heading: 4 Turnover
clauses.quote: Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The bidder must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid document.

clauses.heading: 5 Past Project Experience
clauses.quote: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.
clauses.summary: Experience can be proven by a contract with invoices and self-certification, a client execution certificate, or similar documents.

clauses.heading: 6 Past Project Experience
clauses.quote: should have executed project for supply and installation / commissioning of same or similar Category Products during preceding 3 financial years (i.e. current year and three previous financial years) as on opening of bid, as per following criteria:
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have executed similar supply and installation projects in the preceding 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: 6 Past Project Experience
clauses.quote: (i) Single order of at least 35% of estimated bid value; or (ii) Two orders of at least 20% each of estimated bid value; or (iii) Three orders of at least 15% each of estimated bid value.
clauses.summary: Past orders must be one of at least 35%, two of 20% each, or three of 15% each of the estimated bid value.

clauses.heading: 6 Past Project Experience
clauses.quote: Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid.
clauses.summary: A satisfactory performance certificate from the buyer organisation must be uploaded for the qualifying orders.
